basic_info.description: Apartment #2 at 228 Vicksburg is a light-filled, two-level brand new construction Stock CO-OP that combines an open-plan design with exceptional outdoor living. The main level is defined by soaring ceilings and expansive bay windows overlooking Vicksburg Street, creating a bright and airy setting for the living and dining areas. At the heart of the home, the chef's kitchen is complete with a full Thermador suite and a striking island that anchors the open floor plan and sets the stage for both daily living and entertaining. Upstairs, two bedrooms open directly onto a spacious private deck, where sweeping views extend across Noe Valley toward Mount Diablo, an inspiring backdrop for morning coffee or evening gatherings. A dedicated office or flexible room on the lower level can serve as a third bedroom, offering versatility for work, guests, or family needs. Modern comforts include in-unit washer and dryer, AC throughout, smart lighting, and one tandem parking space. Rich wood floors, custom detailing, advanced soundproofing, and curated finishes throughout speak to a level of craftsmanship rare in new construction, blending timeless design with modern efficiency in San Francisco's most coveted neighborhood.
